payload.claim: The docstring for `citation_defects` says a citation's sentence's other quoted text 'must sit inside the range too' to resolve, which reads as requiring every such string to be in range. The actual check in `_moved_lines` (`any(c in line for c in cite.candidates for line in ranged)`) clears the citation as soon as any one of them is found in range, even if the others are elsewhere or nowhere in the file (confirmed by the module's own case 4 in `tests/test_spec_citations.py`, where `epsilon` in range clears the citation despite `delta` sitting elsewhere). The docstring overstates the strictness of the only public function in this new module.
